children: China property developer's interim revenue rose 66.8% yr/yr for six months ended June 2026
Gross profit fell 74.4% yr/yr, loss attributable to owners narrowed by 20.9%
Group intends to sell Shandong residential and Taizhou, Hangzhou and Shanghai commercial properties as packages
SUBSIDIARY DECONSOLIDATION GAIN – Loss narrowed mainly on a RMB57.9 mln gain from deconsolidating Hangzhou Xinming after its liquidation order
SHANDONG PROJECT SALES – Property sales rose 68.4% to RMB54.9 mln, mainly due to increased sales in phase 4 of the Shandong Project
LOWER OVERHEADS – Selling and administrative expenses fell 52.7%, aided by controls on commercial-project marketing and labour and office costs
